roles.test: Only test targets may depend on it. Allowed in product locks; never linked into a shipped binary.
roles.spike: Stage 0 evaluation only. Must not appear in any manifest or lock under Apps/ or Packages/.

python_tools.note: CI tooling in $SYLVIA_TOOLS_VENV (ADR-0002); never shipped. Licenses from each installed distribution's metadata (toolchain.log). Advisories: none affects the 20 pinned versions or pip 26.2.1, the shared virtualenv's (version-exact search, advisories-search.log); the pip a fresh bootstrap installs is below the minimum recorded for it (unpinned, below). With --toolchain, CI fails unless the virtualenv holds exactly the packages below at their versions, and pip at any version; it warns when pip is below its minimum.

unpinned.name: pip
unpinned.version_is: What the shared virtualenv on the build Mac holds (toolchain.log). Not enforced: a freshly bootstrapped virtualenv holds the pip its Python bundles, 26.1.2 with Python 3.14.6 (ensurepip; round2-reproductions.log), and CI accepts any version (ADR-0014 section 3).
unpinned.minimum_why: GHSA-qwm4-qh6w-59xr (CVE-2026-13346, PYSEC-2026-3721: doubly-encoded package URLs from an index can install files outside the target directory) affects every pip before 26.2.0; every other pip advisory OSV lists is fixed at or before 26.1.2 (advisories-search.log, the any-version query)
unpinned.license: MIT (vendors its own dependencies, each with its license file in the distribution)
unpinned.why: The virtualenv's installer, not a tool the scripts import. Neither Scripts/tools/requirements.txt nor bootstrap.sh pins it: `python3 -m venv` installs the pip that Python 3.14.6 bundles (ensurepip: 26.1.2), and bootstrap.sh never upgrades it. The shared virtualenv holds 26.2.1, so pip was upgraded after that virtualenv was created on 6 October 2026 (its files are dated 08:12 NZDT, before the kickoff commit), by a command that is not recorded (toolchain.log).
unpinned.fix: add pip==26.2.1 to Scripts/tools/requirements.txt (bootstrap.sh's `pip install -r` then installs it in every new virtualenv), and move this entry to packages, where the version is checked exactly
